domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split found in any accessible source. The only India-side records found are inbound imports, e.g. "2024-05-24 | ANHUI WINLAS IMPORT AND EXPORT CO. | N. S. INTERNATIONAL', "Total Shipments 14 Records detected", 5 rows visible). Imports prove purchasing activity, not domestic supply. Domestic supply evidence: none found.
note: Declared HS 960340 (paint brushes/rollers) matches the actual traded goods: paint roller refills and foam rollers under HS 96034020, plus one outlier row under HS 58089090 (ornamental trimmings) on the Nepal shipment — HS is consistent, no correction needed. IMPORTANT: the entity name in the request ('N S INTERNATIONAL N S TOOLS PVT LTD') is a concatenation of two related Delhi firms at the same address, 1/10778-A Subhash Park, Naveen Shahdara — 'N. S. INTERNATIONAL' (14 shipment records, importer only) and 'N.S. TOOLS PRIVATE LIMITED' (27 shipment records, both importer and exporter). The exact combined-name slug on ImportKey returns an empty shell with no records, so the evidence above is attributed to the two constituent firms, not to a single registered legal entity of that combined name. Export activity is real but thin and regional: 2 visible export bills of lading, both to Nepal (Birgunj/Kathmandu) via Raxaul, dated 2024-05-31 and 2026-01-31. No sea/air export to any other destination was seen. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in accessible sources, not estimated. Domestic supply: no traces found in public sources; GST turnover band not public. Role: manufacturer_trader is plausible (imports Chinese roller refills and re-exports/rebrands) but the manufacturing claim is unverified — treat as trader unless factory evidence is produced.
